sources.title: Gemma Model Family - Gemma Documentation
sources.snippet: The family has two halves. A mainline generation — Gemma 1 through Gemma 4 — is the general purpose model most people want. Around each generation sits a set of variants: the same architecture retrained or restructured for one job, like embeddings, safety classification or vision-language tasks.
